project.name: Project ATLAS Foundation
project.description: A provenance-first, fail-closed foundation for projecting explicitly governed knowledge into inspectable graph experiences without treating the projection as the canonical source of truth.

visualization.audience: developers, platform architects, knowledge teams, AI governance teams

architecture_status.current: A bounded local pilot is implemented: live Confluence capture, deterministic projection into pinned GBrain/PGLite, persisted readback, gbrain-read/v1 validation, provenance sidecar, local validate-then-serve, and the WebGL Semantic Atlas workspace.
architecture_status.target: The production ATLAS canonical control plane, PostgreSQL/RLS isolation, separated approval/publication identities, reconciliation and VPS deployment remain target architecture and must not be inferred from the local pilot.

nodes.label: Knowledge author / human source owner
nodes.role: Creates and approves source knowledge outside the projection runtime.

nodes.label: Confluence source set
nodes.role: Canonical source for the bounded pilot capture; page identity, revision and hierarchy are verified.

nodes.label: Project registry & scope gate
nodes.role: Resolves explicit project identifiers and denies unknown, ambiguous or cross-project scope.

nodes.label: Verified source capture
nodes.role: All-or-nothing capture of the declared source set; no partial success path.

nodes.label: Deterministic projection
nodes.role: Maps pages and explicit Confluence hierarchy into GBrain pages/links while carrying provenance.

nodes.label: Pinned GBrain + local PGLite
nodes.role: Derived, rebuildable local persistence for the pilot; not the canonical ATLAS store.

nodes.label: Persisted readback
nodes.role: Builds the graph only from what came back out of persisted state; cannot refetch source data.

nodes.label: gbrain-read/v1 contract & scope validation
nodes.role: Fail-closed contract boundary for graph snapshots; rejects invalid scope, inferred edges and malformed identifiers.

nodes.label: Provenance sidecar
nodes.role: Carries source page, revision, URL and capture metadata for display; missing evidence remains visibly missing.

nodes.label: Validate-then-serve boundary
nodes.role: Serves accepted snapshot bytes locally and refuses invalid/torn state instead of substituting data.

nodes.label: Semantic Atlas workspace
nodes.role: Local graph experience with navigator, evidence inspector, search, focus, zoom and pan.

nodes.label: WebGL graph renderer
nodes.role: GPU-rendered graph stage with explicit renderer failure states.

nodes.label: Accessible DOM interaction layer
nodes.role: Keyboard and assistive-technology semantics share the same projected geometry as the WebGL scene.

nodes.label: Developer / evaluator
nodes.role: Runs the accepted local evidence viewer or the full credentialed pilot pipeline.

nodes.label: CI, repository validation & secret scan
nodes.role: Tests contracts, architecture invariants, viewer behavior, repository consistency and reachable-history secret hygiene.

nodes.label: ATLAS canonical control plane
nodes.role: Target: canonical project registry, source revisions, proposals, approval evidence, audit and projection checkpoints.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL + project_id + RLS
nodes.role: Target: canonical persistence with project isolation and separate service roles.

nodes.label: Separated approval & publication identities
nodes.role: Target: human knowledge decision and publication authority remain technically separate.

nodes.label: Reconciled production GBrain projection
nodes.role: Target: idempotent derived projection with checkpoints, lag measurement and reconciliation.

nodes.label: Production read consumers
nodes.role: Target: graph UI, MCP and search consumers over the derived read side.

edges.label: pilot evidence informs target; never authorizes production

changes.statement: The existing C4 container diagram still labels the local pilot lane as not implemented, while ATLAS-65 plus the ATLAS-39/40 workspace are now implemented. This model separates the as-built pilot from the unimplemented production target.
The repository is public but no root LICENSE or LICENSE.md was observed. Public visibility is not presented as an open-source license.
